  • Method Details

    • confidence

      public Optional<Double> confidence()
      Required. Output only. Closed-world confidence score in `[0, 1]`, equal to the calibrated probability of the winning outcome: - `NoulAnswer`: `max(noul, 1 - noul)` - `ChoiceAnswer`: `p_max` (the probability of `choice`) - `ScoreAnswer`: `p_max` (the highest probability in `probabilities`).

    • legend

      public Optional<Map<String,String>> legend()
      Required. Output only. Rubric description for each non-empty 0-based level index.

    • probabilities

      public Optional<Map<String,Double>> probabilities()
      Required. Output only. Closed-world normalized probability in `[0, 1]` for each 0-based level index.

    • score

      public Optional<Double> score()
      Required. Output only. Probability-weighted expected score (`sum_k k * probability_k`).
